[![wakatime](https://wakatime.com/badge/user/e0eb8abf-071e-4f83-bc68-6f100cbe60db/project/ab8408df-770b-4639-a03e-79fc45fa95cf.svg)](https://wakatime.com/badge/user/e0eb8abf-071e-4f83-bc68-6f100cbe60db/project/ab8408df-770b-4639-a03e-79fc45fa95cf?style=)

> I made this for personal server use! I won't be maintaining it!
## What is this?

SolChat is heavily inspired by [LunaChat](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/lunachat.82293/).
It allows players to type in romaji and automatically converts their messages into Japanese,
making it easy to chat in Japanese even without an IME.
